summary: The giant featherback belongs to a group whose Malaysian identifications have changed as researchers resolve old taxonomic confusion. Chitala lopis was rediscovered in Indonesia after an extinct assessment; Malaysian Chitala records need careful species-level checking.
nativeRange: Sundaland, including Java, Sumatra and Borneo; recent taxonomic work also includes Malaysian records.

habitat.description: Freshwater river systems; Kenyir specimens have been reported cautiously as Chitala cf. lopis rather than a fully confirmed identification.
